title: Meaning Of Life
paragraphs: Huh? What did I just hear?
“Huh?”
A million questions were swirling in my mind. Did he just ask me to kill Father?
“W-Why would I do that?”
“Naofumi-chan!?”
“If you were there, then you must have heard our conversation from somewhere. That’s why, Motoyasu-kun… please, loop again… This time, I want you to save not just us, but also that girl, Raphtalia.”
“But… why does Father have to die for that?”
“That’s because—”
Just as Father was about to explain, I felt something black and ominous rise from his shield.
“Ugh… What is this…? Even the legendary weapons prevent suicide… They’re so meticulously crafted…” Father spoke while holding the shield, which was now seeping out a black power.
He was suppressing some kind of corruption.

This is… the Curse Series…? But why now, of all times? No, Father mentioned suicide prevention. Perhaps the Curse Series has that kind of function as well. Father from the first world once said that heroes must not die. It must be something engraved into the legendary weapons.

“Motoyasu-kun… The reason is simple. It’s what you told me about the conditions for looping. The death of one of the Four Holy Heroes or the formation of a barrier by the Four Guardian Beasts… I can’t let you kill Ren or Itsuki, so… I figured if I die…”
Father is trying to force the loop to activate!? Is this world really that hopeless?

“I know it’s extremely selfish… It’s cruel, trampling over the efforts of Ren, Itsuki, so many people… and even you, Motoyasu-kun. But… if it means there are people who can be saved… I’ll gladly… ugh…”
The black aura of the shield grew even more intense. Then, Father transformed it into a shield that looked utterly fragile and raised his head to meet my gaze.
I… I think my hands are shaking more than ever before. My whole body won’t stop trembling.

Father is asking me to kill him. Because too many people cannot be saved in this world. He’s trying to sacrifice himself for the sake of the world. And he’s been consumed by the Curse to the point where it’s eating away at his mind.

What am I supposed to do? I want to see Filo-tan. Deep down, I feel like Father is telling me that Filo-tan doesn’t exist in this world. But… I don’t want to give up. Is it really okay to sacrifice this world for a better future?
That thought weighed heavily on me. Last time, I chose to loop without hesitation because I wanted to see Filo-tan. But… was that choice really the right one?
“No, Naofumi-chan! You can’t do that! You’re a hero… You’re the hope of this world!”
“Coming from Sadeena-san, who’s already accepted death… who wants to die and follow after Raphtalia-chan? Do you really have the right to stop me?”
“We haven’t even confirmed if that girl, Raphtalia-chan, is really dead! Yet you’re already trying to follow after her, Sadeena-san… You have no right to stop me!”
“Naofumi-chan!”
“It’s fine. I might die now, but the looped version of me… will still be there. The next me… will figure something out!”
“Why are you so desperate, Naofumi-chan!?”
What am I supposed to do? It feels like my brain is about to overheat. But… this isn’t the kind of situation I can run away from. Father, resisting the curse, looked down and gazed at the sister.
“When Sadeena-san told me, ‘Being protected sometimes makes the one being protected suffer, Naofumi-chan needs to realize that,’ it was people like Sadeena-san that made me truly want to do my best.”
Then, Father turned his gaze toward me.

“I was believed in and protected by Motoyasu-kun, Ren, and Itsuki. That’s why I want to live up to that trust. Because everyone believed in me, I wanted to become someone who could protect others. But Sadeena-san taught me the pain of being the one protected. Just like yesterday, she unknowingly pushed herself too hard to protect me.”

Oh… this is Father’s anguish as the Shield Hero. Because Father’s power is specialized in protecting, he feels compelled to help everyone. And there are many who want to protect Father, myself included. The sister also mentioned… that those who are protected know that pain as well. Even Filo-tan had a conflicted look on her face whenever Father was hurt. Even if it’s part of the duty and an unavoidable reality, you can’t deny what’s in your heart.
“Sadeena-san, earlier, you used the words ‘reason to live,’ right?”
“Y-Yes.”
“Can I… be part of that reason?”
“Huh?”
“If… if it’s truly confirmed that Raphtalia-chan is dead, can I become a reason for you to keep living, Sadeena-san?”
At Father’s words, the sister was left stunned, wearing a rare expression of shock.

“Sadeena-san, I want to protect you. Just as you tried to protect me… because all I can do is protect! I want to save you from the call of the underworld. If I can’t do that… then even if it means sacrificing this life, my memories, and my feelings… I’ll still see it through!”

As he declared this, Father’s shield released an even darker black aura. Ugh… this power, I recognize it. Back when I was still deceived by the pig, before we fought the Pope, I fought against Father. This is similar to the power of the Curse I felt back then. But… the flow of this power feels different from that time.
“Mo-Motoyasu-kun! Hurry, I—!”

…I understand. Not as a hero, but as a person, Father wants to protect the sister! To achieve that, he’s willing to sacrifice the present. For a better future, I… have made his resolve. I have fully understood Father’s determination!
“I understand, Father! I will—”
But before I could point my spear forward, the sister wrapped her arms around Father.
“It’s okay now… It’s okay. Naofumi-chan… Motoyasu-chan.”
The sister is crying. Then, she lifts up Father, who can’t stand on his own without support.
“…I understand. Sister, I won’t give up on living. Even if Raphtalia-chan is no longer in this world… I’ll do my best for Naofumi-chan and everyone who’s trying so hard!”
“Ugh… ah…”
Father shakes his head, resisting the shield’s control. Eventually, after hearing the sister’s words, the power of the curse weakens.
“Sa…dina-san. It’s a promise, okay? I… I think that your cheerful side, your care for your friends… those are… wonderful things, so… don’t give up on living.”
“Yeah… yeah…”
The sister embraces Father. Eventually, she and Father, who had suppressed the shield’s power, smiled together.
“I feel… a little better now.”
The sister, regaining her usual self, spoke cheerfully to Father.
“I feel like having a drink. Naofumi-chan, how about a drink?”
“Ahaha, now that’s the Sadeena-san I know.”
“Oh? Really?”
The sister wraps her arms around Father’s.
“But take it easy. You’re still not fully recovered from your cold.”
“Oh… cough, that’s right. But I still want a drink.”
“Yes, yes. Just a little, okay?”
“Father, what should we do? Should we loop?”
Father’s words have a point.

“That’s one option… for a better future… It’s true that a lot of things have gone wrong. When I think of the people who have died because of us… that might be the best choice. So, Motoyasu-kun, you have the right to decide.”
“Naofumi-chan.”
The sister’s gaze is slightly stern. She’s right. I agree with her opinion.
“Isn’t it too soon for that now?”
I’m not ready to give up on the present just yet. No matter how bad things are now, I won’t give up until the time comes to decide. I’m sure somewhere under this sky, Filo-tan is waiting for me.
“I understand. Motoyasu-kun, I’m sorry for asking too much.”
“It’s not a problem. I won’t give up on Filo-tan or sister.”

I’m sure this was a necessary step to stop the sister from wanting to die. Magic can be very convenient, but for someone like the sister, it seems she can even harm herself with it. Ha! My flames of love will never consume me! That means… my feelings are still not enough, huh? This means I need to train once again to make my feelings for Filo-tan reach her!
“Oh my, Motoyasu-chan is strong-willed too. I have to make sure I don’t lose to the determination of Naofumi-chan and Motoyasu-chan.”
“Yes… Sadeena, please.”
“Okay, okay. I won’t give up anymore. Naofumi-chan, you better be prepared.”
“Yeah.”
Father and the sister exchange glances. Is it just my imagination? I feel like there’s more intensity in their gaze than before.
“Well then, Naofumi-chan, I’ll rest and regain my strength to get better.”
“I’ll bring you something later.”
“I’m looking forward to it. Also… I want to talk with you tonight, so come after everyone’s asleep. If you don’t come, I’ll come to you.”
“U-uh… okay!”
With that, the sister seemed to have recovered quite a bit and lay down to sleep. Her harsh coughing had completely stopped. This must be that thing… they say illness comes from the mind.
“Sadeena-san looks like she’s going to get better. I’m glad.”
“Thanks to Father’s persuasion.”
“I hope so. Alright, Motoyasu-kun, let’s go back to everyone. Then, we’ll make some food to help Sadeena-san recover.”
“Understood!”

And so, we returned to where the village’s slaves were. That night, Father went to the sister’s room with a slightly cheerful demeanor. They were probably having a good time, sharing drinks. Just like in the first world, when Father was in a good mood after talking with the sister.
